description: This file contains the implementation of the Cart controller in the Opencart e-commerce platform. It manages actions related to the shopping cart, including displaying cart contents, updating the view, and removing items from the cart.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for managing shopping cart operations, including displaying cart contents and removing items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds and returns the cart view with product details, totals, and links.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs the cart page content by calling the index method.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified product from the cart and returns JSON response indicating success or error.
